s: the one who overcomes receives white garments
q: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments

s: the one who overcomes keeps name in book of life (will not be blotted out)
q: I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life

s: the one who overcomes is confessed before Father (the speaker's Father) (name confessed before the Father and his angels)
q: I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

s: the one who overcomes becomes temple of my God (pillar, never leaves)
q: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more.

s: Jesus has seven stars
q: He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things

s: the one who overcomes receives name new Jerusalem (name of the city written on him)
q: I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem

s: the one who overcomes sits on throne (with the speaker)
q: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne

s: assembly in Philadelphia has door (open, no one can shut it)
q: behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut

s: assembly in Philadelphia has power little
q: that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name

s: assembly in Philadelphia keeps the speaker's word (did not deny his name)
q: that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name

s: assembly in Laodicea is lukewarm (neither hot nor cold)
q: you are neither cold nor hot

s: assembly in Laodicea says rich and in need of nothing (self-sufficient claim)
q: ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing,’

s: assembly in Laodicea is wretched, miserable, poor, blind, naked (unaware of it)
q: don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked

s: Jesus has key of David (opens and shuts with no one able to reverse)
q: he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens

s: Jesus reproves and chastens assembly in Laodicea (those he loves)
q: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten.

s: new Jerusalem comes down from heaven (from God)
q: the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God

s: Jesus is holy
q: He who is holy, he who is true

s: Jesus is true
q: He who is holy, he who is true

s: Jesus is a Faithful and True Witness
q: The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of God’s creation

s: Jesus is the Beginning of God's creation
q: The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of God’s creation

s: Jesus has relationship to Father (the speaker's Father) (sat down with his Father on his throne)
q: as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne

s: Jesus loves assembly in Philadelphia
q: to know that I have loved you

s: God sits on throne
q: one sitting on the throne

s: four living creatures has part eyes (before and behind, around and within)
q: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within.

s: four living creatures has part six wings (each one)
q: each one of them having six wings

s: four living creatures has habit unceasing praise of God (day and night, saying Holy, holy, holy)
q: They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”

s: God is a Lord God, the Almighty
q: Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!

s: God lives forever and ever
q: him who lives forever and ever

s: God created Creation (all things)
q: for you created all things

s: God appearance jasper stone and sardius (he looked like)
q: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius

s: twenty-four elders sit on twenty-four thrones
q: On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting

s: twenty-four elders wear white garments
q: dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads

s: twenty-four elders wear crowns of gold (on their heads)
q: dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads

s: twenty-four elders worship God (fall down before him and throw their crowns before the throne)
q: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever

s: four living creatures located at throne (in the middle and around it)
q: In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

s: book (held by him who sat on the throne) is held by God (in his right hand)
q: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

s: Lamb is a Lion of the tribe of Judah, Root of David (one who has overcome)
q: Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”

s: redeemed people (bought by the Lamb) is made kings and priests (to God)
q: and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”

s: redeemed people (bought by the Lamb) will reign on earth
q: and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”

s: twenty-four elders possess harps and golden bowls of incense (each one has a harp; bowls hold the prayers of the saints)
q: each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

s: angels (around the throne) has number ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands
q: The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,

s: angels (around the throne) is located around the throne (with the living creatures and elders)
q: a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders.

s: book (held by him who sat on the throne) is written inside and outside
q: a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

s: book (held by him who sat on the throne) has part seven seals (of the book) (sealed shut)
q: a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

s: Lamb is located in the middle of the throne (also among the four living creatures and elders)
q: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain

s: Lamb has appearance as though slain (standing)
q: a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes

s: Lamb has horns seven
q: having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

s: Lamb has eyes seven (the seven Spirits of God, sent into all the earth)
q: having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

s: Lamb is worthy to open the book (because he was killed and bought people for God)
q: “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood

s: Lamb redeems redeemed people (bought by the Lamb) (with his blood, out of every tribe, language, people, and nation)
q: bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,

s: Lamb opens seven seals (of the book) (one by one)
q: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals

s: Death rides pale horse
q: And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death.

s: Death is followed by Hades
q: Hades followed with him.

s: Death has authority over one fourth of the earth (to kill by sword, famine, death and wild animals)
q: Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.
